configurePresets.name: cs-compiler-windows-msvc-msvc_2022_17
configurePresets.description: MSVC (cl) of Visual Studio 2022, for the Ninja generators
configurePresets.$comment: Ninja: configure from a Visual Studio 2022 developer environment (vcvars); the external toolset and architecture let IDEs set it up. The clang-cl of this Visual Studio (VCINSTALLDIR of the environment), not the first clang-cl on PATH: its version matches the standard library of the MSVC toolset (MSVC 14.52 needs Clang 22, a standalone LLVM may be older)
